test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Both Reeta and Ronika / has won / the dance competition / this year.
solution:
The correct answer is "**has won**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The segment that contains a **grammatical error is "has won"**.
 
• The **subject of the sentence is "Both Reeta and Ronika"**, which is a **plural subject.**
 
• Thus, the **verb should also be plural. **The **correct verb form would be "have won".**
